summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-15) 发现 10 个 Commit 信号，12 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: OpenCode 官方 Copilot 插件发布
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 发布官方 GitHub Copilot 插件，标志着开源 AI 编程工具开始正式进入 IDE 插件生态，与商业产品直接竞争。

engineering_signals.title: Zed 引入细粒度工具权限控制
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 编辑器为 AI Agent 引入了细粒度的工具权限按钮，允许用户精确控制 Agent 对文件系统、终端等敏感操作的访问，显著提升了本地 Agent 的安全性。

engineering_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 增强协作与事件流
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入了协作工具事件流和自动刷新机制，增强了多 Agent 协作和实时状态同步的能力，为构建复杂的自动化工作流奠定了基础。

engineering_signals.title: Zed 实现子Agent渲染与线程历史
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 实现了在对话线程中渲染子 Agent 并统一历史记录，这提升了多 Agent 协作时的用户体验和上下文连贯性，解决了 Agent 间切换时的上下文割裂问题。

engineering_signals.title: Agno 优化异步向量搜索性能
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 框架修复了 MongoDB 和 Qdrant 异步搜索中的阻塞问题，通过使用异步 Embedder 防止事件循环阻塞，这对于高并发 RAG 应用的性能至关重要。

engineering_signals.title: OpenDevin 迁移至 UV 包管理器
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenDevin 开始迁移到 UV（Rust 编写的极速 Python 包管理器），并添加 PEP 621 支持，反映了 Python 生态工具链正在向更快的 Rust 工具演进。

engineering_signals.title: Cline 添加 create-pull-request 技能
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cine 内置了创建 PR 的技能，使 Agent 能够独立完成从代码修改到提交 Pull Request 的完整闭环，进一步增强了其自动化软件开发能力。

engineering_signals.title: LangChain DeepAgents 强化子Agent管理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: DeepAgents 添加了在创建子 Agent 时传递名称的功能，并修复了消息键缺失的错误，这表明多 Agent 系统正在向更结构化、更可调试的方向发展。

research_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 发布 gpt-5.2-codex 模型
research_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 发布了下一代代码模型 gpt-5.2-codex，并迅速集成到 Cline 和 OpenCode 等主流工具中，标志着 AI 编程助手能力的重大升级。

research_signals.title: Gemini CLI 引入行为评估框架
research_signals.why_it_matters: Google Gemini CLI 添加了行为评估框架，这表明 AI 编程工具的发展重点正从单纯的代码生成转向对 Agent 行为可靠性和可预测性的系统性评估。

releases.summary:
This week's release includes most of [December's quality week items](https://github.com/orgs/zed-industries/projects/61) and is packed!
Highlights include subpixel (ClearType-style) text rendering on Windows and Linux to improve text clarity on standard DPI displays, the ability to favorite/pin Agent models, cycle them via `alt-tab`, and queue messages in the agent panel, a `git: create pull request` command, UI controls to restart/stop individual language servers, a which-key-like modal (enable with `{"which_key": {"enabled": true}}`), improved Markdown list editing via `extend_list_on_newline` and `indent_list_on_tab`, many performance boosts — and much much more!

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the ability to mark language models as favorites and pin them to the top of the list. This feature is available in the native Zed agent (including text threads and the inline assistant), and in external agents. ([#44297](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44297), [#45528](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45528); thanks [aqrln](https://github.com/aqrln))
- Agent: Added the ability to cycle through favorited models using the `alt-tab` keybinding. ([#45032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45032))
- Agent: Added the ability to queue messages in the agent panel. ([#46019](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46019))
- Agent: Added a right-click context menu for the thread view. ([#45440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45440); thanks [zchira](https://github.com/zchira))
- Agent: Added the ability to regenerate the auto-summarized title of threads via the "Regenerate Thread Title" button, available in the ellipsis menu of the agent panel. ([#43859](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43859); thanks [aeroxy](https://github.com/aeroxy))
- Agent: Added the ability to configure timeouts for context server tool calls. The new global `context_server_timeout` setting controls the default timeout (default is 60s, max: 10min). Additionally, per-server timeouts can be configured using the `timeout` field within servers defined in the `"context_servers"` setting. ([#45378](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45378))
- Agent: Added MCP prompt support to agent threads. Prompts from MCP servers now appear in the slash command menu when typing `/` in agent threads. ([#43523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43523); thanks [mdliss](https://github.com/mdliss))
- Agent: Show tool call parameters when the agent asks for confirmation to run a tool. ([#45931](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45931))
- Agent: Made tool calls' raw input visible in the agent UI. ([#45097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45097); thanks [tsoernes](https://github.com/tsoernes))
- Agent: Use up-to-date token counts from LLM responses when reporting tokens used per thread. ([#44943](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44943))
- Agent: Added OpenAI `gpt-5-codex` model to the assistant. ([#39989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39989); thanks [mstallone](https://github.com/mstallone))
- Agent: Added support for OpenAI's `/responses` endpoint for models that don't support the `/chat/completions` API. ([#39989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39989); thanks [mstallone](https://github.com/mstallone))
- Agent: Improved Agent Panel performance when terminals are scrolled offscreen. ([#45537](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45537))
- Agent: Updated context lengths for several Mistral models to match Mistral’s recommended values. ([#45194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45194); thanks [guiopen](https://github.com/guiopen))
- Agent: Added support for authenticating Amazon Bedrock with API keys (bearer tokens), including via environment variable or the UI. ([#41393](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41393); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))
- Agent: Improved: MCP tools are now automatically reloaded when a context server sends a `tools/list_changed` notification, eliminating the need to restart the server to discover new tools. ([#42453](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42453); thanks [tsoernes](https://github.com/tsoernes))
- Copilot now supports [Next Edit Suggestions](https://code.visualstudio.com/blogs/2025/02/12/next-edit-suggestions). ([#44486](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44486))

### Git

- Added `git: create pull request` command to open a pull request for the current branch. ([#42959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42959); thanks [tommyming](https://github.com/tommyming))
- Added the ability to copy a commit's SHA in the commit view. ([#45478](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45478); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added support for collapsing/expanding entries with your keyboard while in the git panel (tree view). ([#45002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45002); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Added a `Restore File` action in the project panel context menu to discard uncommitted file changes. ([#42490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42490); thanks [korbindeman](https://github.com/korbindeman))
- Added git clone open listeners using `zed://git/clone?repo=<git-url>`. ([#41669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41669); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))

- Added global Git settings to enable/disable `git status` and `git diff`. ([#43326](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43326); thanks [leoliu0605](https://github.com/leoliu0605))

### Debugger

- Conditionally display the debugger panel icon based on the `debugger.button` setting to avoid too many error logs. ([#45544](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45544); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

### Languages

- C++: Include namespace symbol in the outline view. ([#45794](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45794); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein))
- C/C++: Added highlighting for escape sequences. ([#46116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46116); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))

- Markdown: Lists now continue automatically when you press Enter (unordered, ordered, and task lists). This can be configured with `extend_list_on_newline` (default: true).
